prompt:
ENGLISH DIALOGUE ONLY, spoken in English. Use @Audio1 as the sole source of dialogue, wording, voice, performance and timing. Fuzzby speaks first, then Zenny speaks; each character lip-syncs only during their own spoken section. The listener keeps the mouth closed. No additional dialogue, vocalisations, invented voices or on-screen text.

Use @图1 only for the exact opening composition, positions and lighting continuity; @图3 only for Fuzzby’s identity, proportions, features and accessories; @图2 only for Zenny’s identity, proportions, features and accessories; @图4 only for the flower-meadow world, low sun, sky and shadow plate.

Shot 1: Continue directly from the previous shot’s motion. Bee-height 35mm, one continuous character-led camera move that begins in the previous final framing, pulls back to a wide flower-corridor view, follows Fuzzby’s flight at readable distance, tightens for the impact, then becomes one medium two-shot with both bees in frame through the recovery, discovery, both spoken sections and final button. Begin exactly on @图1. Stylised feature-quality 3D CGI matching @图1, with the low sun visible through the meadow, soft sky colour, backlit pollen motes and long flower shadows unchanged.

Fuzzby and Zenny are the characters from their references — match the references 100%, every feature and accessory exactly as shown. Both wings keep beating whenever airborne. No extra characters, no character redesign, no crystals on the bees.

The camera lets the previous final frame breathe for an instant: Fuzzby still proud from his last lucky success, Zenny nearby at her flower with flat calm. The camera pulls back into the open corridor before Fuzzby launches himself into another showy pass. His joy powers the takeoff: chest pushed forward, one grand wave thrown toward Zenny, a glance back to make sure she is watching, then he flies ahead like a tiny parade leading itself.

During the lead-in of Fuzzby’s spoken section of @Audio1, before his mouth begins the line, the camera follows him through flowers at a readable distance. His grin lasts past the point where his body has lost the path. A shoulder brushes a tall stem, the contact tilts him off balance; his feet bicycle to recover, but the recovery overcorrects; he glances back again, still trying to sell the performance, and that delayed look costs him the turn.

Only at the last instant does delight flip into wide-eyed alarm. His face, and only his face, plants into the pollen-heavy yellow centre of a flower. His body, arms, legs and wings remain outside the flower and readable. The flower centre compresses deeply under the face contact, the petals cup around the impact, and the connected stem bows with his weight. One golden pollen burst erupts outward, never hiding his body or Zenny. As the flower rebounds, it springs him backward into the two-shot, and the burst leaves a single loose powdery golden handlebar moustache across his upper lip. It is bright pollen-yellow granular material only: no goatee, no chin tuft, nothing dark anywhere on his face.

From the crash recovery onward, keep Zenny in frame with Fuzzby. No solo close-up of Fuzzby. The meadow and the sky remain visible behind both bees. Zenny hovers beside him with tiny wing corrections, watching flatly, mouth closed. Fuzzby does not know what the crash has stamped onto him. He blinks through the recoil, regains his hover with a small wobble, then one hand accidentally brushes the pollen across his upper lip.

The touch changes everything. Instead of alarm, delight blooms through him. He pinches the loose pollen moustache between two fingers and strokes it with careful ceremony, chin lifting, eyebrows waggling, chest swelling as if the accident has awarded him a title. A small golden clump detaches and plops away unnoticed. He keeps preening, never fully motionless; each hover correction becomes part of the performance.

When Fuzzby’s mouth begins in his own spoken section of @Audio1, lip-sync only Fuzzby. He turns toward Zenny in the same medium two-shot and delivers the spoken question with total sincerity, trying to make his hovering body look dignified while one hand keeps returning to the pollen moustache. Zenny listens with her mouth closed, almost unmoving except for wing beats and a slow, unimpressed eye shift.

Let Zenny’s deciding pause play in the two-shot. Fuzzby waits with eager confidence, still beaming under the powdery golden moustache, giving it the smallest proud adjustment. As Zenny’s spoken section of @Audio1 begins, lip-sync only Zenny. Fuzzby’s mouth stays closed while he receives her flat verdict, his smile still convinced that she is confirming his triumph. Zenny’s delivery stays dry and calm; her body refuses to join his chaos.

Only after Zenny’s own spoken section is completely finished, she turns half away toward her flower. The first tiny private cheek-lift escapes, warm but hidden from Fuzzby. He misses it, gives the moustache one more satisfied stroke, and hovers tall, beaming, with loose golden clumps catching the low sun rays. Hold on the medium two-shot for two seconds after @Audio1 finishes: Zenny half-turned away with the tiny cheek-lift just escaping, Fuzzby proudly stroking the single golden-pollen moustache, meadow and sky unchanged behind them. Silence.
